description: utopia-php/migration 2.1: resources (auth, databases, storage, functions, sites, messaging, integrations, settings, domains, backups), the transfer with its cache and status counters, the sources (Appwrite over the API or the database, Supabase, NHost, Firebase, CSV, JSON) and destinations (Appwrite, CSV, JSON, a local backup), and halaxa/json-machine's streaming parser the JSON source reads with.

scrub.reason: Cache keys and sequences are uniqid() values from the clock; JSON and CSV exports use uniqid() for their temporary directories
destinations stamp resources without dates with the current time

resource.new.doc: new <class>(...$args) for a class under Utopia\Migration\Resources (named arguments; resources as handles)

resource.describe.doc: Every public get*/is* method of a resource without required parameters, by name (Values::describe)

resource.set.doc: A setter ($resource->setStatus(...), ...): {"$self": true} for the fluent $this

resource.equal.doc: Whether two handles are the same resource (assertSame)

mask.reason: getTraceAsString() of the previous exception: a PHP stack trace (file paths and line numbers of the engine's frames); Rust has no PHP stack and reports the previous error's message

selector.scope.doc: new ResourceSelector(...) and its scope id and type

cache.get.doc: $cache->get($name or $resource): resources summarised (name, id, status, message), row counts as strings

transfer.new.doc: new Transfer($source, $destination) (the handles keep naming them)

transfer.run.doc: $transfer->run($resources, $callback, $rootResourceId, $rootResourceType): the batches the callback got (or the exception it threw, `callback.throw`)

mask.reason: getTraceAsString() of the previous exception: a PHP stack trace; Rust reports the previous error's message

source.export_resources.doc: $source->exportResources($resources), through run(), which installs the callback it hands batches to

mock.source.doc: The suite's MockSource (variants: plain, legacy_child, counting, status)

mock.source_state.doc: A MockSource's resources, run count and selector

mock.destination_state.doc: A MockDestination's data (ids by group and type) and run count

fs.get.doc: Reads a file, null when missing (glue)

json_source.new.doc: new Sources\JSON($resourceId, $filePath, new Local($root), null), or JSON::fromResourceIds()

export.props.doc: resourceId, resourceChildId and outputFile of a CSV or JSON destination (the suite reads them by reflection)

export.local_file.doc: The local export file of a CSV or JSON destination (the suite's getLocalRoot())

export.discard_local.doc: Removes a CSV or JSON destination's local directory (the suite's recursiveDelete())

source.props.doc: resourceId and resourceChildId of a CSV or JSON source (the suite reads them by reflection)

waivers.Utopia\\Migration\\Destination::getSourc: Accessor subsumed by Rust types: the Transfer owns the source and hands it to Destination::run
waivers.Utopia\\Migration\\Destination::setSourc: Accessor subsumed by Rust types: the Transfer owns the source and hands it to Destination::run

tests_waived.vendor/utopia-php/migration/tests/Migrat: Checks that a PHP subclass declaring the legacy three-parameter run() still satisfies Target's abstract signature, a PHP inheritance rule; Rust's Source and Destination traits fix one signature, so there is no behaviour to compare
